Jamaica Dogwood Fish Poison Bark; Piscidia. Profile Jamaica dogwood, the root bark of Piscidia erythrina (P. piscip- ula; Ichthyomethia piscipula) (Leguminosae), has analgesic, antispasmodic, and sedative properties. It is mainly used for in- somnia due to neuralgia or nervous tension. The bark and twigs of Jamaica dogwood have been used as a fish poison.
